quest.title: Their Childhood
quest.description: You meet two children playing at the Fleuve Cendre...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: You won't find the hiding spot I picked this time!

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: If you hide in those places, it'll be your parents who come looking for you, not me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: I'm playing hide-and-seek with my brother! Trouble is... Well, he knows all my hiding spots...

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Verut, we've been playing here for so long that you've hidden everywhere there is to hide.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: As for those places where you can't hide... If I've told you once, I've told you a thousand times why you can't go there.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Oh, those places aren't that dangerous! Mom and Dad exaggerate way too much!

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: But when you hide in those places, your clothes and pants will get dirty or torn. Mom and Dad work hard enough already, so don't give them one extra thing to worry about.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Oh... Alright...

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Really? You wanna play with me?

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Verut, don't make trouble for others! Sorry, all my brother ever thinks about is playing...

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: #Awesome! See, brother? {M#He}{F#She} agreed! I'll definitely hide better than you, just watch!

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: *sigh* Alright then. In that case, we'll be counting on you.

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Verut, don't hide in those places I told you about, alright? If our parents get back — they're getting back late today — and see your clothes all tattered, no one's gonna help you patch them up.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Got it, I got it... Ugh, you're such a nag! I'm gonna go hide now. You hide too, quickly!

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: You go first. I already know where I'm hiding.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: #Really? You're bragging, I know it! {M#He's}{F#She's} gonna find you for sure!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Aurele and Verut hide in their respective spots...

choices.text: It's alright. You're not bothering me.
Well, I might not be able to find you.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Whoa! You found me! Did my brother tell you about this spot!?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Bah, alright, guess you're pretty good at this. I'm going to our meeting place.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Whoa! You found me! Did my brother tell you about this spot!?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Bah, alright, guess you're pretty good at this. I'm going to our meeting place.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Whoa! You found me! Did my brother tell you about this spot!?

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Bah, alright, guess you're pretty good at this. I'm going to our meeting place.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: When will Verut grow up... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not hiding?

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: I never really intended to. If Verut didn't bother me as often as he does, I would prefer to read my books for a while more.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Our parents work so hard, so I've got to grow up fast and help lighten their load.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: But Verut keeps saying that he misses Mom, so I have to accompany him. That way, he'll stop crying for a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: Sorry, I've said too much. I'll be waiting at our meeting spot.

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: I can only hope that Verut won't dirty his clothes this time...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: #Hey! Did you tell {M#him}{F#her} about my spot? How did {M#he}{F#she} find me that quickly?

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: I've told you this before. Your hiding spots are way too obvious.

choices.text: Experience is on my side, I fear.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Really? In that case, will you come over next time too? Could we play together again?

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Our parents aren't at home in the day, and my big brother's always reading... No one has time to play...

response.speaker: Aurele
response.text: Well, you can do what I do and read the books on the shelves. That's a lot more useful than playing hide-and-seek.

response.speaker: Verut
response.text: Well... I'd rather go look for Mom and learn sewing from her...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: Can't find me...

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: This spot looks good...

dialogues.speaker: Aurele
dialogues.text: I hope Verut will enjoy himself.

dialogues.speaker: Verut
dialogues.text: I hope he's having a good time...
